text: the interference between them IS the signal: 440 and 445 Hz together produce a 5 Hz beat, but the Lissajous figure shows something else — an x that fills the circle, not a line. proximity doesn't merge them; it makes their difference visible.

images.alt: top: spectrogram showing two horizontal bands at 440 and 445 Hz rising together from dark. bottom: amplitude waveform showing a clear 5 Hz beat envelope with rapid internal oscillation
a Lissajous figure showing 440 Hz against 445 Hz — the trace fills a circle in an x pattern, densest at center and corners, bounded by a faint circle reference line
